turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so tell me who entered that zero, and when, before anything else.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Don't thank me yet. You entered a zero before anyone called me, and my son found out from his phone in the middle of class. Why was that done before I was told?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess is not evidence, Hale. Even the company that sells that checker says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable" is your opinion, not a document. Show me the report, the date it ran, and who looked at Owen's work after it did.
So I had to give him a zero.
You didn't have to. You chose to, and you chose it before calling his parent. Who else signed off on that zero?
I hope you understand my position.
I understand that you entered a mark on a machine's number and didn't call home. Your position is not the issue here. Owen's mark is. Is that zero still in the gradebook right now?
